about: Three State College cafes and bakeries for the demo, from the team's scraped photo set (cafes-and-bakery.zip, branch dev-david of HelpingYouSellFoodCompile26). Seven items per store were picked from the 65 in that set. Loaded with: npx tsx scripts/import-demo-restaurants.ts <api_base_url> --credentials <file.json> --data scripts/data/demo-cafes-bakeries.json. Allergens are demo placeholders (only the obvious ones for each item); the real merchants must confirm them.
photo_note: item.photo is the JPEG from the zip (max 1200 px) under photo_base_url. The API sets Deal.photo_url only from POST /merchants/{id}/drafts, so the importer sends that photo there and the backend stores its own copy under photos/.

deal_defaults.deal_price_rule: regular price x (100 - item.discount_pct)%, rounded down to a multiple of 25 cents
deal_defaults.pickup_end_rule: the store's closes_at when that is at least 90 minutes after the import runs, else 23:30
deal_defaults.kind_rule: surplus when pickup_end is within 2 h of closes_at, else timed (same rule the API uses for manual deals)
